description: This file contains various functions related to checkout operations in a version control system, including directory creation, removal, file writing, entry checkout, and handling of special cases like submodules and symlinks.

methods.name: void create_directories(const char * path,int path_len,const struct checkout * state)
methods.description: Creates a directory structure for a given path, handling existing directories and symlinks, used during checkout to prepare the filesystem.

methods.name: void remove_subtree(struct strbuf * path)
methods.description: Recursively deletes a directory subtree, used to remove existing directories before checkout.

methods.name: void * read_blob_entry(const struct cache_entry * ce,size_t * size)
methods.description: Reads a blob object from the repository given a cache entry, returning the data and size, used to retrieve file contents.

methods.name: int open_output_fd(char * path,const struct cache_entry * ce,int to_tempfile)
methods.description: Opens a file descriptor for output, either as a temporary file or a regular file, based on the cache entry mode.

methods.name: int fstat_checkout_output(int fd,const struct checkout * state,struct stat * st)
methods.description: Performs an fstat on a given file descriptor, with reliability checks, used to obtain file metadata after writing.

methods.name: int streaming_write_entry(const struct cache_entry * ce,char * path,struct stream_filter * filter,const struct checkout * state,int to_tempfile,int * fstat_done,struct stat * statbuf)
methods.description: Streams a cache entry's blob directly to a file descriptor, using filters if applicable, during checkout.

methods.name: void enable_delayed_checkout(struct checkout * state)
methods.description: Initializes delayed checkout state, allowing deferral of file writing, used for optimization or complex filtering.

methods.name: int finish_delayed_checkout(struct checkout * state,int show_progress)
methods.description: Completes all delayed checkout operations, applies filters, and verifies correctness, ensuring all paths are processed.

methods.name: void update_ce_after_write(const struct checkout * state,struct cache_entry * ce,struct stat * st)
methods.description: Updates cache entry metadata after writing to the filesystem, such as timestamps and flags.

methods.name: int checkout_entry_ca(struct cache_entry * ce,struct conv_attrs * ca,const struct checkout * state,char * topath,int * nr_checkouts)
methods.description: Handles the checkout of a specific cache entry, including path resolution, conflict detection, and writing files or symlinks.

methods.name: void unlink_entry(const struct cache_entry * ce,const char * super_prefix)
methods.description: Removes a cache entry from filesystem, handling special cases like submodules and directories.

methods.name: int remove_or_warn(unsigned int mode,const char * file)
methods.description: Removes a file or directory, issuing warnings if necessary, depending on file type.

methods.name: int check_path(const char * path,int len,struct stat * st,int skiplen)
int create_file(const char * path,unsigned int mode)
void mark_colliding_entries(const struct checkout * state,struct cache_entry * ce,struct stat * st)
int string_is_not_null(struct string_list_item * item,void * data UNUSED)
int write_entry(struct cache_entry * ce,char * path,struct conv_attrs * ca,const struct checkout * state,int to_tempfile,int * nr_checkouts)

ctags.signature: (const char * path,int len,struct stat * st,int skiplen)

ctags.signature: (struct cache_entry * ce,struct conv_attrs * ca,const struct checkout * state,char * topath,int * nr_checkouts)

ctags.signature: (const char * path,int path_len,const struct checkout * state)
